renders._yaml:
- component: advanced_viz
  id: sunburst
  title: Community composition by lineage
  description: |-
    Each arc is a taxon: the rings run from superkingdom at the centre out to species, sized by its share of the estimated genome copies and coloured by phylum. It answers which lineages make up the community.
    How to read: wide arcs are the dominant lineages, and an arc that fans out into many species is a diverse group. Taxa Melon could not name at a rank are labelled unclassified. Click an arc to zoom in on it.
    Note: abundance is a share of estimated genome copies from marker genes, not of reads, and the rows are pooled across samples.
    Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xinehc/melon/master/README.md
  kind: sunburst
  config:
    colour_by_rank: phylum
  roles:
    ranks:
    - superkingdom
    - phylum
    - class
    - order
    - family
    - genus
    - species
    abundance: abundance

- component: card
  title: Species detected
  description: |-
    The hero number is the count of distinct named species Melon identified, and the bars rank the phyla that hold most of them. It answers how rich the community is and where the diversity sits.
    How to read: a phylum with many species is a diverse group. Unclassified lineages are left out, so the count is a lower bound.
  column: species
  aggregation: nunique
  aggregations:
  - count
  secondary_layout: top_n
  breakdown_col: phylum
  top_n_count: 4
  filter_expr: col('species') != 'unclassified'
  caption: species, by phylum
  headline: true

- component: card
  title: Genome copies
  description: |-
    The hero number is the total of estimated genome copies, and the bars rank the phyla by their copies. It answers how large the profiled community is and which phyla dominate it.
    How to read: copies are estimated from marker genes, so they count genomes rather than reads and are less biased by genome size. Compare with the species card: a phylum with few species but many copies is dominated by a few organisms.
    Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xinehc/melon/master/README.md
  column: copy_number
  aggregation: sum
  aggregations:
  - max
  secondary_layout: top_n
  breakdown_col: phylum
  top_n_count: 4
  caption: genome copies, by phylum

- component: card
  title: Identity to the reference
  description: |-
    The hero number is the mean identity of the marker-gene reads to their reference genome cluster, and the histogram shows its distribution over lineages. It answers how close the community is to known genomes.
    How to read: values near one mean close relatives are in the database. Low values flag novel or distant lineages whose assignment is less certain. Melon publishes no pass mark for it.
    Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xinehc/melon/master/README.md
  column: identity_mean
  aggregation: average
  aggregations:
  - min
  - max
  secondary_layout: histogram
  caption: mean identity per lineage

- component: table
  title: Lineages and genome copies
  description: |-
    Each row is a full lineage from superkingdom to species with its estimated genome copies, relative abundance, mean identity and the number of lineages pooled into it. It answers what Melon found.
    How to read: sort by abundance to see the dominant species and check their identity.
